The Druid Bryona has requested my aid with a dire matter in Eldhaime Keep. Demons have invaded, targeting the refugees she had taken in under her protection. 

At Firebreak Manor, we found some refugees who escaped the demonic onslaught. Bryona insists we search the path for other survivors. I can only hope we are not already too late.

As I entered the city for respite, a loud commotion broke out in the heart of Cerrigar. At the center of this unrest appears to be a Druid named Bryona. Anxious and enraged townsfolk surround her.

 I should approach and speak with Bryona to uncover the problem.

The Druid Bryona has requested my aid with a dire matter in Eldhaime Keep. Demons have invaded the Keep, targeting the refugees she had taken in under her protection. Concerned for their safety, Bryona has gone ahead to Firebreak Manor, south of Cerrigar. She awaits my arrival there. 

I should make haste and speak with her to learn more.

Alas, on the road to Eldhaime Keep, Bryona and I found but a single survivor. The path beyond was littered with ruin, and the stench of brimstone thickened with every step. 

The demons are not merely raiding - they are pouring forth from within the Keep itself. Something dark festers at its heart, and I must uncover what has awakened it.

The demons are not merely raiding - they are pouring forth from within the Keep itself. Something dark festers at its heart, and I must uncover what has awakened it.

In Eldhaime Keep, amidst scorched stone and the mangled remains of demon and man, I uncovered a relic. It is a strange, circular relic fashioned like a mechanical wayfinder. Whatever it is, it drew the demons here like moths to flame.

I must bring it to Bryona, who remains within the Keep. Perhaps she will recognize its origin.

The Horadric Wayfinder guided me deep into Demon's Wake, where I unearthed a vessel containing Astaroth's blood. As my hand brushed its surface, his voice slithered into my mind. There can be no doubt: Astaroth, the scourge of Scosglen, lives once more.

Bryona has since returned to Cerrigar. I must find her at once and share what I have learned.

In Cerrigar, Bryona was visibly shaken upon learning of the blood relic. The relic's shape is a perfect match for one of the empty slots on the Horadric Wayfinder that led me to it. 

I should affix the blood relic to the Wayfinder and see what unfolds.

The moment I joined the blood relic to the Horadric Wayfinder, the ancient mechanism awakened. Together, they serve a greater purpose yet to be revealed.

Though Bryona holds little love for the Horadrim, she must be told in Cerrigar. Perhaps with this newfound power, we may yet stand a chance to strike down Astaroth once and for all.

Bryona identified the relic as Horadric - though its true function remains a mystery. I can feel it resonating, pulling me toward the depths of Eldhaime Keep, to a crypt known as Demon's Wake. 

With Bryona occupied elsewhere, the task falls to me alone. I must descend into Demon's Wake and uncover the source of these mysteries.
